title: 第538章 阿蛮的恐怖第537章 九霄神雷神无道偷袭
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
那股自阿蛮体内苏醒的力量，并未掀起任何惊天动地的波澜。
没有法则的轰鸣，没有灵力的狂潮。
它只是存在着，古老、蛮荒，带着一种纯粹到极致的毁灭与霸道，仿佛凌驾于这片天地的一切规则之上。
神无道射出的那道足以秒杀圣皇的毁灭神光，在距离楚风眉心不过三寸之地，突兀地停滞了。
时间与空间，在这一刻都显得无比怪异。
紧接着，一只小小的，粉嫩的拳头，毫无征兆地出现在了神光之前。
是阿蛮。
她不知何时，已经从雕像之下，瞬移般地出现在了楚风的身前。
那张脏兮兮的小脸上，第一次露出了认真的神情，一双懵懂的大眼睛里，满是怒气。
咔嚓。
一声轻响。
神无道那道蕴含了极致毁灭法则的神光，在那只小小的拳头面前，如同脆弱的玻璃一般，寸寸碎裂，化作点点光芒，消散于无形。
整个过程，安静得可怕。
静。
死一般的寂静。
在场的所有天骄，无论是藏于暗处的石毅，还是手持帝兵的楚清歌，亦或是那高高在上的太古魔子，全都瞪大了眼睛，脸上写满了无法理解的震撼。
这……怎么可能？
一个看起来手无缚鸡之力的小女孩，竟然用拳头，打碎了神庭神子志在必得的偷袭？
“这……”
神无道瞳孔剧烈收缩，他死死地盯着挡在楚风身前的阿蛮，心中掀起了滔天巨浪。

刚刚那一瞬间，他感受到了什么？
不是法则，不是灵力，而是一种更加本源，更加古老，让他神魂都在战栗的恐怖力量！
这小丫头，究竟是什么怪物？！
楚风也心有余悸，他看着身前那道小小的背影，心中同样充满了震惊。
他刚想开口说些什么。
阿蛮却猛地转过头，气鼓鼓地看着神无道，用一种稚嫩却无比认真的声音，一字一句地说道：“不准你欺负大哥哥！”
话音未落，她小小的身子，便化作一道残影，主动朝着神无道冲了过去。
没有花哨的招式，没有绚烂的光影。
就是简简单单的一记直拳，朝着神无道的面门轰去。
然而，就是这看似普通的一拳，却让神无道感受到了前所未有的死亡危机。
他感觉自己周围的空间都被一股无形的力量彻底锁死，避无可避！
“神王盾！”
神无道发出一声怒吼，他没有丝毫犹豫，直接从体内唤出了一面流转着七彩神光的古朴盾牌。
极道圣兵！
而且是纯粹的防御性极道圣兵！
这是神庭之主赐予他的保命最后底牌，足以抵挡虚神境强者的全力一击！
他就不信，这小丫头能一拳打穿一件极道圣兵！
咚！！！
一声沉闷到极致的巨响，在整个空间内回荡。
阿蛮的拳头，结结实实地砸在了神王盾之上。

下一瞬，让所有人眼珠子都快要掉出来的一幕发生了。
那面坚不可摧的极道圣兵神王盾，在阿蛮的拳头下，发出了不堪重负的哀鸣，整个盾面都深深地凹陷了下去，布满了蜘蛛网般的裂痕。
而神无道，更是如遭太古凶兽撞击，口中狂喷出一口鲜血，连人带盾，被一拳轰飞出数千米之远，狼狈地砸进了神殿的墙壁之中，生死不知。
一拳！
仅仅一拳！
content_en:
The power awakened from Aman's body did not cause any earth-shattering waves.
There is no roar of laws, no frenzy of spiritual power.
It just exists, ancient and wild, with a kind of pure destruction and domineering to the extreme, as if it is above all the rules of this world.
The destructive divine light shot by Shen Wudao, which was enough to kill the Holy Emperor instantly, suddenly stopped just three inches away from Chu Feng's eyebrows.
Time and space seemed extremely weird at this moment.
Then, a small, pink fist appeared in front of the divine light without any warning.
It's Aman.
At some point, she appeared in front of Chu Feng like teleporting from under the statue.
That dirty little face showed a serious look for the first time, and a pair of big, ignorant eyes were full of anger.
Click.
A soft sound.
The divine light of Kannadao that contained the ultimate law of destruction, in front of that small fist, was like fragile glass, shattered inch by inch, turned into little rays of light, and dissipated invisible.
The whole process was eerily quiet.
quiet.
Deathly silence.
All the geniuses present, whether it was Shi Yi hiding in the dark, Chu Qingge holding the imperial weapon, or the aloof ancient devil, all had their eyes widened, and their faces were filled with incomprehensible shock.
How is this possible?
A little girl who seemed to have no strength, actually used her fists to break the sneak attack that Shenting Shenzi was determined to win?
"This..."
Shen Wudao's pupils shrank violently, and he stared at Aman who was blocking Chu Feng, feeling a huge wave in his heart.
What did he feel at that moment?
It's not a law, it's not spiritual power, but a more original and ancient terrifying power that makes his soul tremble!
What kind of monster is this little girl? !
Chu Feng also had lingering fears. He looked at the small figure in front of him, and his heart was also filled with shock.
He was about to say something.
Ah Man suddenly turned his head, looked at Shen Wudao angrily, and said word by word in a childish but extremely serious voice: "You are not allowed to bully big brother!"
Before she finished speaking, her small body turned into an afterimage and rushed towards Kannadao.
There are no fancy moves, no gorgeous lights and shadows.
It was a simple straight punch, directed towards Kannadao's face.
However, this seemingly ordinary punch made Shen Wudao feel an unprecedented death crisis.
He felt that the space around him was completely locked by an invisible force, making it impossible to escape!
"God King's Shield!"
Kannadao let out an angry roar, and without any hesitation, he directly summoned an ancient shield with colorful divine light flowing from his body.
The ultimate holy soldier!
And it is a purely defensive ultimate holy weapon!
This is the last trump card given to him by the Lord of the Divine Court to save his life, which is enough to withstand the full blow of a strong man in the False God Realm!
He didn't believe that this little girl could punch through an extremely holy weapon with one punch!
Boom! ! !
An extremely dull loud noise reverberated throughout the entire space.
Ah Man's fist hit the God King's shield firmly.
The next moment, a scene happened that made everyone's eyes almost fall out.
The indestructible shield of the Holy Weapon God King let out an overwhelmed cry under Aman's fist. The entire shield surface was deeply dented and covered with spider web-like cracks.
As for Shen Wudao, it was like being hit by an ancient ferocious beast. A mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth. He and his shield were blasted thousands of meters away by a punch, and he was smashed into the wall of the temple in embarrassment. He didn't know whether he was alive or dead.
One punch!
Just one punch!
